meta.source: Blizzard Game Data journal-encounter + Wowhead tooltip API
meta.readMe: Ability text and damage magnitudes come from Wowhead's tooltip endpoint, which is the only source carrying tuned numbers for this tier -- Blizzard's /data/wow/spell/<id> returns 404 for these ids and the in-game journal text ships 'X' placeholders. A magnitude here is ONE difficulty's value and the endpoint does not say which; cross-check against measured damage taken in profiles/<spec>-<difficulty>.json before quoting it as a Mythic number.

encounter.name: Entombed Sentinels
encounter.description: The Blood and Breath of Ula'tek bar the way to Vashnik's inner sanctum. Ancient golems that long stood guard within the vaults, now corrupted by the venom of the nightmarish monster they imprisoned.

notes.title: Overview
notes.bodyText:
The Sentinel Golems of Ula'tek are filled with the caustic venoms flowing throughout the temple. The Breath of Ula'tek animates venom to destroy invaders while the Blood of Ula'tek infects players with deadly toxins. 

At 100 energy the Sentinels come together to fill their venom levels with [Vitriolic Stasis], restoring health to the weaker Sentinel and infecting all players with [Helical Toxins].

$bullet;[Empowering Slam] and [Bloodvenom Injection] increase in intensity each time they strike the same target.
$bullet;[Helical Toxins] is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly 4 applications.

notes.title: Vashnik the Malignant
notes.bodyText: Constantly seeking to improve his toxins, Vashnik infects players and obfuscates their attempts to save themselves.
bullets: Constantly seeking to improve his toxins, Vashnik infects players and obfuscates their attempts to save themselves.

abilities.title: Shifting Protovenom
abilities.description:
Vashnik contaminates random players with a prototype venom, inflicting 233354 Plague damage every 2 sec.

Coming into contact with another Protovenom neutralizes them harmlessly, while colliding with an uncontaminated player causes a Protovenom Eruption.

abilities.title: Protovenom Eruption
abilities.description: A burst of non-compatible toxins erupts, inflicting 291692 Plague damage to players within 10 yards and knocking them away.

abilities.title: Ula'tek's Dominance
abilities.description: While the Entombed Sentinels are within 40 yards of each other, they empower each other with Ula'tek's Dominance, reducing their damage taken by 99%.

abilities.title: Mark of Acid
abilities.description: The Breath of Ula'tek applies its mark to players within 40 yards every 5 sec, inflicting 10834 Nature damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Mark of Blood
abilities.description: The Blood of Ula'tek applies its mark to players within 40 yards every 5 sec, inflicting 10834 Shadow damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Living Venom
abilities.description: Venom slime ejected by the Breath of Ula'tek returns to the golem after 4 sec, inflicting 375033 Nature damage to players struck.

abilities.title: Venom Coagulation
abilities.description: The Breath of Ula'tek vomits up a sticky mass of venom that animates itself into a living slime.

abilities.title: Contaminate
abilities.description: The Venom Coagulation continually radiates a contaminating essence, inflicting 116677 Nature damage to all players every 3 sec.

abilities.title: Toxic Droplets
abilities.description: The Breath of Ula'tek sprays forth many toxic droplets, which each erupt into Noxious Blast after 12 sec. Players can destroy the droplets by stepping on top of them, suffering 375033 Nature damage.

abilities.title: Noxious Blast
abilities.description: The Toxic Droplet violently explodes, inflicting 375033 Nature damage to all players.

abilities.title: Empowering Slam
abilities.description: The Breath of Ula'tek slams its current target, inflicting 2500220 Physical damage. Each time the golem slams the same target, it empowers itself and gains 10% additional Physical damage dealt until it slams a different target.

abilities.title: Blood Venom
abilities.description: Blood venom from the Blood of Ula'tek creates a toxic pool upon expiration, inflicting 166681 Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within. Greater applications of blood venom create larger toxic pools.

abilities.title: Blighted Blood
abilities.description: The Blood of Ula'tek infects players with blood venom, inflicting 208352 Shadow damage every 2 sec for 18 sec.

abilities.title: Unstable Miasma
abilities.description: The Blood of Ula'tek marks a player with unstable miasma. After 8 sec, the miasma erupts, inflicting 5000440 Shadow damage split evenly among players within 7.5 yards. This impact spreads applications of Clinging Murk among the targets struck.

abilities.title: Clinging Murk
abilities.description: Clinging blood venom inflicts 100009 Shadow damage every 2 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Bloodvenom Injection
abilities.description: The Blood of Ula'tek injects its current target with a blood venom, inflicting 2500220 Physical damage immediately with an additional 41670 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Vitriolic Stasis
abilities.description: Upon reaching 100 energy, both Sentinels rush together and begin to balance their fluid levels over 30 sec. This process reduces their damage taken by 99% and restores health to the weaker Sentinel until it matches the other.

abilities.title: Helical Toxins
abilities.description:
The Sentinels combine fluids to infect all players with an entangled blood venom, inflicting 16668 Plague damage every 2 sec for 28 sec. 

A victim colliding with another player combines the strength of the venom. Reaching exactly 4 applications of Helical Toxins neutralizes the venom, removing it harmlessly.

abilities.title: Cultivated Burst
abilities.description: Upon expiration, Helical Toxins erupts in a violent explosion, inflicting 625055 Plague damage to its host and an additional 208245 Plague damage every 1 sec for 1 min.
